minimum_safe_fix: At both internal intermodal entry guards, accept exact endpoint coverage in the public/detailed graph OR the available merged station graph. Keep routing itself scoped to the proper graph.

For exact station endpoint candidate enumeration, fallback to station graph region when absent from public graph, and compare legacy station stops through verified corresponding station portal identities rather than geographic acquisition-region labels.
Do not strip node_id/node_ids or XYZ, substitute nearby roads, change HUH region_id to AUS, weaken __hkExactSourceRegion globally, or treat source_region_id as the routing graph region.
Leave public street walk routing on I/E, and exact station transitions on u/r. An accepted coverage guard establishes data coverage only, not a complete reachable journey.
